settings.tabs.2.name: Keys

guide.tips.move: Move with WASD — firing is automatic
guide.tips.firstCard: Press Space twice to launch the suggested combo (practice card: Precision Strike always succeeds; you can also pick with 1–5)
guide.tips.firstFail: A failure still gives OP +1 — at 10 you get a guaranteed-success seal
guide.tips.firstPair: Play matching cards together for a big skill and better odds
guide.tips.skillReady: TP is full — press Q for your skill
guide.tips.firstSeal: Shift+Space submits with a seal = guaranteed success
guide.tips.firstMinus: Minus card: alone it is discarded for OP 3, inside a combo it is a gamble
guide.tips.firstDisruption: Disruptions fade with time or when their source is killed; Comms Restore clears them at once

meta.tips.boss: Focus fire during the boss's 3-second op-card charge to cancel it and expose a weak point
meta.tips.lob: Red circles mark where shells will land. Step outside them
meta.tips.dash: Red lines show a tank's charge path. Sidestep it
meta.tips.early: Early on, follow the XP stars and take HP / move speed at level-ups
meta.tips.seals: You still had a seal. Use Shift+Space for a guaranteed success
meta.tips.fewSubmits: One Space fills the suggested combo. Play cards often
meta.tips.default: Every 5 combo successes add a tactical choice to your next level-up
meta.tips.spendMerit: You have {merit} merit left — buy starting upgrades (level, weapon, TP) in Deployment to start stronger

ending.title: Reaching the Yalu
ending.lines.0: The counteroffensive that began on the Nakdong crossed the peninsula's mountains and rivers to its northern edge.
ending.lines.1: Countless units guarded each other's backs, and nameless soldiers opened the way.
ending.lines.2: The front will move again. But today, we came this far together.
